backlog.title: dev-workflow-platform.md — 70 FRs (FR-001–FR-069) with 0% implementation
backlog.detail: Entire spec describes SQLite-backed feature request platform. Source implements in-memory workflow engine. Zero traceability comments exist. Either archive the spec or open work items for 70 unbuilt requirements.
backlog.recommendation: Triage spec status: mark as aspirational/archive or open TheFixer work items. Do not leave a live Specifications/ document at 0% implementation.

backlog.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md — 10 FRs (FR-TMP-001–010) with 0% coverage
backlog.detail: Spec covers risk classification, Playwright E2E test generation, auto-PR creation, AI PR review, auto-merge. No source file references any FR-TMP-* ID. Platform/ scripts exist but have no traceability comments.
backlog.recommendation: Link existing platform/ scripts to FR-TMP-* IDs via comments, or mark spec as future-work aspirational.

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer checks only 1 of 8 plans — PASSED verdict is misleading
backlog.detail: Enforcer picks the most-recently-modified Plans/*/requirements.md (currently self-judging-workflow). 7 plans are never verified: dependency-linking, image-upload, duplicate-deprecated-status, orchestrated-dev-cycles, orchestrator-cycle-dashboard, dev-cycle-traceability, dev-workflow-platform.
backlog.recommendation: Update CLAUDE.md verification gate: `for f in Plans/*/requirements.md; do python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py --file "$f"; done`. Or extend enforcer to aggregate all active plans.

backlog.title: fastTrack field silently dropped — FR-WF-004 partially unimplemented
backlog.detail: POST handler strips fastTrack field — never passed to store.createWorkItem(). isFastTrack() in router.ts references 'handled by overrideRoute' but the mapping is never performed. Submitters sending fastTrack: true silently get placed in full-review.
backlog.recommendation: Persist fastTrack on WorkItem model and check it in isFastTrack(), or map it to WorkItemRoute.FastTrack at creation. Add // Verifies: FR-WF-004 comment and test case.

backlog.title: Duplicate Frontend test files with divergent coverage and mock setups
backlog.detail: Two test files cover the same components: tests/ (older, smaller mock surface) and tests/pages/ (newer, more complete). Both run in Vitest, potentially inflating pass counts while hiding coverage gaps when one silently drifts.
backlog.recommendation: Consolidate into the tests/pages/ versions (more complete), delete older duplicates, verify test count consistency.
